name: icloud-mail-mcp
description: Read-only iCloud Mail connector for Claude (remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers)

ICLOUD_USER.description: Your iCloud email address, e.g. name@icloud.com.

ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD.description: An Apple app-specific password. Make one at account.apple.com: Sign-In and Security, App-Specific Passwords.

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: A long random password you make up and save (at least 16 characters). You type it once when connecting Claude.
